description: This file provides mechanisms for locating and managing the Zephyr in-work-tree package within a CMake build environment. It includes functions and macros for setting directories, searching for Zephyr packages, and handling version checks, primarily used for configuring Zephyr-related builds.
external_files: CMake modules and configuration files related to Zephyr

methods.name: set_zephyr_dir
methods.description: Updates the Zephyr_DIR variable to point to the directory containing the Zephyr package, based on a candidate path.

methods.name: get_search_paths
methods.description: Generates a list of parent directories for searching Zephyr packages, based on a starting path and preferences.

methods.name: check_zephyr_package
methods.description: Checks for the presence of Zephyr packages in various locations, performs version checks, and sets the Zephyr directory accordingly.
